title: From basin attributes to a living atlas

phases.title: Specify the atlas
phases.description: Catalogue sources and write a method for every BasinATLAS attribute.
phases.gate: Resolve source ambiguities and review all recipe specifications.

phases.title: Reproduce the baseline
phases.description: Implement and compare recipes against the original atlas, one family at a time.
phases.gate: Pinned inputs, declared tolerances, independent rerun and signed comparison report.

phases.title: Build basin history
phases.description: Assess 2000–2026 availability and develop explicitly versioned annual extensions.
phases.gate: Coverage, source transitions and provisional years documented for each attribute.

phases.title: Preserve the evidence
phases.description: Store versioned basin observations, sources, runs and snapshot membership.
phases.gate: Persistent IDs, geometry versions, provenance and tested recovery of a frozen snapshot.

phases.title: Freeze an atlas edition
phases.description: Publish reviewed maps and a reproducible scientific data package.
phases.gate: Complete observation periods and immutable manifest; 2026 remains provisional until year-end and source release.

phases.title: Maintain the living atlas
phases.description: Refresh eligible sources, publish annual changes and extend thematic modules.
phases.gate: Monitored updates, regression checks and revision history.

phases.title: Connect the knowledge
phases.description: Connect basins, rivers and indicators through reviewed semantic relationships.
phases.gate: Scientific concepts, units, temporal support and relationship provenance reviewed.
